description: Weak, mixed unit; no clean rule found. Two loose patterns: (1) openings (ply<=9) where the opponent holds the bottom centre (0,3), I hold (0,1) and (0,2) is empty, with no opponent stone at (0,4); (2) middle games where the opponent owns (4,2) and has 2+ stones, none of mine, on the up-right diagonal (2,0)-(3,1)-(4,2)-(5,3). Many exceptions: single distant stones often switch it off.
effect: Small: when forced high it shifts at most about 0.05-0.13 of probability, mostly toward column 4; zeroing it changes the move distribution by under 0.05.
notes: 7 score calls. Best dev F1 0.167 (P 0.137, R 0.21, AUROC 0.59), sim share 0.09 (p3). Tried: col-2 top theirs (F1 0.07), diagonal-only (0.12), early-only (0.10), col-2 height-5 (0.09), plus mirror diagonal (0.11), col-3 height cap (0.13). Minimal pairs: removing their (4,2) or (3,5) in a 4.3 position kills it; adding any stone to column 3 kills it; transpositions give the same value (it depends on the board). Looks like a mixture or a random direction; four synthesis positions reach 11.4-12.6 against a dev max of 8.5.
